title: LIMS and ELN program specification
purpose: Hydrate collaborators with vendor-evaluation requirements, canonical data semantics, migration behavior, event integration, and specification-by-example scenarios.

primary_surfaces.use: Material capabilities to compare across products and implementation options
Canonical temporal, identity, measurement, unit, tenant, event, and evidence semantics
Evidence questions and conformance levels for vendor evaluation
Flyway, expand-and-contract, reconciliation, and Debezium outbox requirements
Representative executable questions for configured environments
Principal-level reasoning prompts and evidence sources

hydration_notes: Treat conformance levels as descriptions of available evidence; organizational processes retain consequential decisions.
Keep documented, configured, exercised, and observed claims visibly distinct.
Use vendor-supported lifecycle mechanisms and mature infrastructure products before introducing program-owned code.
Keep raw regulated or sensitive evidence in governed storage and compare redacted metadata here.
